messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي كأعداد صحيحة بأرقام 0-9 فقط، بلا فاصلة أو كلمة ملحقة، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"verse":31,"chapter":4,"text":"Ponder now by yourself, how much fruit of wickedness a grain of evil seed has produced."},{"verse":32,"chapter":4,"text":"When the grains which are without number are sown, how great a threshing floor they will fill!”"},{"verse":33,"chapter":4,"text":"Then I answered and said, “How long? When will these things come to pass? Why are our years few and evil?”"},{"verse":34,"chapter":4,"text":"He answered me, and said, “Don’t hurry faster than the Most High; for your haste is for your own self, but he who is above hurries on behalf of many."},{"verse":35,"chapter":4,"text":"Didn’t the souls of the righteous ask about these things in their chambers, saying, ‘How long will we be here? When does the fruit of the threshing floor come?’"}],"book_code":"2ES","chapter":4}

response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 31,32,33,34,35 in this chapter.
